In this week's Autocar India Quick News, Hyundai has launched the Bayon at Rs 10 lakh while Land Rover has started assembling Defender 110 in India. In two-wheeler news, KTM has updated the 200 Duke with new features while Triumph has launched the Tiger 1200 in India. Shrey Vaid has all the details.
Editor: Deven Bhalla
